text:
```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  dco-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Verify DCO Sign-off
    steps:
      - name: Check DCO
        uses: 1Password/check-dco@v2
        with:
          review: true
```
